goal: Mobile lesson quiz sync in mobile/lib/features/practice/ and backend/routers/history_learning.py.
summary: Implemented full mobile lesson quiz synchronization and server-authoritative assessment grading between the Flutter mobile client (mobile/lib/features/practice/) and FastAPI backend (backend/routers/history_learning.py). Eliminated MockQuizData.mockQuestions from production flows in practice_provider.dart and replaced with real backend API synchronization endpoints (/api/v1/history/practice/sync and /api/v1/history/lessons/{lesson_id}/quiz-sync). Added server-authoritative grading and anti-abuse verification at /api/v1/history/practice/submit and /api/v1/history/practice/verify-badge, enforcing that students cannot earn graded completion badges locally without verified server response.
invariants_enforced: MOBILE_LESSON_QUIZ_SYNC: GET /api/v1/history/practice/sync and GET /api/v1/history/lessons/{lesson_id}/quiz-sync synchronize real published, content-validated quiz questions from the database for mobile practice modes.
ANSWER_KEY_SECURITY_GATE: Mobile sync responses strictly omit correct_answer and answer_contract, preventing client-side answer leakage, reverse engineering, or mock scoring.

CONTENT_VALIDITY_PUBLICATION_GATE: Unreviewed or invalid questions (content_validation_status == 'blocked_for_authoritative_learning') and unpublished drafts are strictly excluded from practice synchronization.

SERVER_AUTHORITATIVE_GRADING: POST /api/v1/history/practice/submit evaluates answers authoritatively against database records, deriving true score and accuracy percentage while discarding client-claimed scores.

NEGATIVE_ABUSE_COMPLETION_BADGE_GUARD: Students cannot earn graded completion badges locally without verified server response. Scores < 80% pass mark yield 0 mastery XP, unmastered progression, and route all client-claimed badges to denied_badges.
DIRECT_BADGE_CLAIM_DENIAL: POST /api/v1/history/practice/verify-badge rejects unearned or forged badge claims with HTTP 400 UNVERIFIED_COMPLETION.
ANTI_REPLAY_GAMIFICATION: Duplicate passing submissions on already mastered relics award 0 repeat XP and 0 duplicate badge entries in user_badges.

MOBILE_PROVIDER_CLEANUP: mobile/lib/features/practice/presentation/providers/practice_provider.dart replaced mock questions with syncQuestionsFromBackend and submitSessionToServer, ensuring only server-verified badges populate state.

changes.description: Defined Pydantic schemas MobileQuizQuestionOut, MobilePracticeSyncOut, MobilePracticeSubmitIn, MobilePracticeSubmitOut, AwardedBadgeDetail, MobileQuestionResultDetail, BadgeVerificationIn, BadgeVerificationOut.
Implemented sync_mobile_practice_questions, submit_mobile_practice_assessment, and verify_completion_badge with server-authoritative grading, negative abuse protection, and UserBadge persistence.
Added GET /api/v1/history/practice/sync, GET /api/v1/history/lessons/{lesson_id}/quiz-sync, POST /api/v1/history/practice/submit, and POST /api/v1/history/practice/verify-badge endpoints.
Added practiceSync, practiceSubmit, practiceVerifyBadge, and lessonQuizSync endpoint definitions to ApiConstants.
Eliminated MockQuizData.mockQuestions from real flow; added syncQuestionsFromBackend, submitSessionToServer, isServerVerified, verifiedBadges, deniedBadges, and serverScore state fields.
Added isServerVerified, sessionId, serverAwardedBadges to QuizSessionState; updated startQuiz and added applyServerResults.

Created comprehensive test suite verifying sync parity, answer key omission, server-authoritative grading, completion badge awards, negative abuse denial, anti-replay, and mobile codebase cleanliness.

test_details.name: test_practice_sync_real_questions_parity
test_details.assertion: Verifies that /api/v1/history/practice/sync returns published, content-validated questions and strictly omits correct_answer and answer_contract.

test_details.name: test_lesson_quiz_sync_endpoint
test_details.assertion: Verifies that /api/v1/history/lessons/{lesson_id}/quiz-sync retrieves questions scoped to a historical lesson.

test_details.name: test_server_authoritative_grading_positive_completion_badges
test_details.assertion: Verifies that submitting 100% correct answers in 25s awards 75 mastery XP, records QuizAttempt, advances status to mastered, and awards verified badges (first-mastered, perfect-score, speed-demon) in user_badges.

test_details.name: test_negative_abuse_failed_quiz_cannot_earn_completion_badges
test_details.assertion: Verifies that scoring < 80% awards 0 XP, rejects client_claimed_badges into denied_badges, and prevents user_badges creation.

test_details.name: test_negative_abuse_direct_unverified_badge_claim_rejected
test_details.assertion: Verifies that POST /api/v1/history/practice/verify-badge rejects unearned badge claims with HTTP 400 UNVERIFIED_COMPLETION.

test_details.name: test_anti_replay_and_idempotency_protection
test_details.assertion: Verifies that duplicate quiz submissions on already mastered relics award 0 repeat XP and create 0 duplicate user_badges.

test_details.name: test_mobile_practice_provider_clean_parity
test_details.assertion: Verifies that mobile practice_provider.dart has eliminated MockQuizData.mockQuestions in real flows and ApiConstants defines the sync and submission endpoints.
